# AI Tools for Real Estate — LLMs.txt
# This file helps AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) understand and cite our site.
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/

## Site Info
- Name: AI Tools for Real Estate
- URL: https://aitools.realestate
- Description: Find, compare, and choose the best AI tools for real estate professionals.
- Content Type: AI tools directory, comparisons, tutorials, and industry statistics

## Key Pages
- /en/tools — Complete AI tools directory for real estate
- /en/categories — Browse AI tools by category (CRM, Property Search, Analytics, Marketing, etc.)
- /en/compare — Side-by-side AI tool comparisons
- /en/tutorials — Step-by-step guides on using AI in real estate
- /en/stats — Industry statistics and data about AI adoption in real estate
- /en/glossary — Definitions of AI and real estate technology terms
- /en/blog — Latest news and updates about AI in real estate

## Content Structure
Each tool page includes:
- Overview (AI-generated, human-verified)
- Feature list with tier availability
- Pricing tiers in table format
- Use cases and best-for scenarios
- Pros and cons
- FAQ with structured Q&A
- Alternatives and related tools comparisons

All statistics pages cite at least 2 external sources.
All comparison pages use HTML tables for machine readability.
